# Home Environment Manager v0.6.0b1 — Public beta 1

**Prerelease · 20 October 2026 · Home Assistant 2026.10+**

This is an **opt-in HACS beta**, not a stable release. v0.5.1 remains the latest stable version. The internal Home Assistant domain stays `air_quality_advisor`; existing config entries, device and entity IDs, saved settings, legacy services, Lovelace card alias and Announcement Hub routing are retained.

## What's included

- Coordinated per-room climate profiles for **occupied, unoccupied, away and sleep**; native HEAT/COOL thermostats and heat-only, cool-only, native range and DRY-only capability awareness.
- Conservative thermostat setpoint supervision, optional legacy PID, independently guarded secondary thermostat targets, and commissioning-only non-compressor relay/PWM/proportional actuators.
- Indoor humidity policies, opt-in native humidity setpoint/power supervision, demand-based CO₂ extraction and PM2.5 filtration with independent fan speed/power driver permissions.
- Deterministic window-efficiency recommendations for conditional cooling, heating and dehumidification opportunities, gated by actual active equipment and measured safe outdoor conditions.
- Room-level conflict arbitration, exact area targeting, cross-config-entry equipment ownership, manual override pauses, persistent command history and crash recovery safeguards.
- Read-only `home_environment_manager.climate_diagnostics` (legacy alias also available), coordinated Lovelace climate cards, and German/Greek/English climate text with existing international locales.
- Home Assistant-native 256/512 light/dark brand PNG icons/logos, translated entity state/action icons, HACS-ready GitHub release tag, and standalone **manual installation ZIP**.

## Install through HACS

1. **Back up Home Assistant first.**
2. Add/open the [Home Environment Manager custom Integration repository](https://my.home-assistant.io/redirect/hacs_repository/?owner=Chreece&repository=HA-Air-Quality-Advisor&category=integration).
3. In HACS choose the integration's **Redownload** or version-selection menu, enable **Show beta versions**, select **v0.6.0b1**, and download.
4. Restart Home Assistant. Confirm your existing sensor and window recommendations work, then run read-only `home_environment_manager.climate_diagnostics` from **Developer Tools → Actions**.
5. Keep experimental power/mode switching **disabled** unless your particular equipment has completed real hardware commissioning. An OFF native thermostat is not restarted automatically.

If prerelease selection is unavailable, download the release asset `HA-Air-Quality-Advisor-v0.6.0b1.zip`, extract its `custom_components/air_quality_advisor/` folder into your Home Assistant configuration folder and restart. **The ZIP is for manual installation: HACS uses the tagged repository contents.** Roll back by choosing stable v0.5.1 in HACS, then restarting.

## Important beta limits and safety

- **No real HVAC, compressor, fan, humidifier, relay or power commissioning has been performed.** Python tests, mocks, static checks, Hassfest and HACS checks are not physical safety certification.
- Experimental `dry_fan_mode_auto`, dedicated fan power, humidity power and direct non-compressor actuators remain **opt-in and disabled by default**. Native DRY/FAN_ONLY changes require the exact commissioned device and verified independent compressor/defrost, frost, condensate and electrical protections. Do not use unverified generic relays for compressors.
- Humidity, CO₂ and particulate controls require fresh, correct-room, capability-verified sensors; missing data, conflicting device owners and unsupported native modes hold rather than guess.
- Window features **advise**, never actuate a window or automatically switch off operating equipment.
- Before upgrading, preserve a backup of HA configuration and `.storage` (the integration does not store permanent user data inside its source directory). After downgrading review any new v0.6 settings.
- See the [scientific control design](https://github.com/Chreece/HA-Air-Quality-Advisor/blob/v0.6.0b1/docs/CLIMATE_CONTROL_DESIGN.md) and [full README](https://github.com/Chreece/HA-Air-Quality-Advisor/blob/v0.6.0b1/README.md).

Please file reproducible feedback under [GitHub issues](https://github.com/Chreece/HA-Air-Quality-Advisor/issues) with redacted read-only climate diagnostics and your actual HA entity capabilities, not credentials or sensitive addresses.

**Release status:** Beta; stable v0.5.1 unchanged.
